description: Source code for a memory technology device (MTD) manipulation tool, including functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, verifying, and managing MTD devices, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Opens an MTD device, trying to resolve device number from /proc/mtd if possible.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Checks and opens an MTD device, retrieves device info, and sets global variables.

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Checks if a block at a given offset is bad, for NAND flash.

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erases a block at a given offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to an MTD device at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Validates and opens one or multiple MTD devices specified by name or label.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks one or multiple MTD devices.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of an MTD device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verifies the content of an MTD device against a file by MD5 checksum.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Writes an image to an MTD device, handling partitioning, bad blocks, and optional FIS layout.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Appends a file to the JFFS2 partition on the device.
